relations.definition:
WITH book_currency_evidence AS (
         SELECT b.ledger_book_id,
                CASE
                    WHEN upper(TRIM(BOTH FROM b.base_currency)) ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'::text THEN upper(TRIM(BOTH FROM b.base_currency))
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END AS base_currency,
            count(l_1.entry_id) FILTER (WHERE l_1.transaction_currency IS NOT NULL) AS currency_bearing_legs,
            count(l_1.entry_id) FILTER (WHERE l_1.transaction_currency IS NOT NULL AND l_1.functional_currency IS DISTINCT FROM upper(TRIM(BOTH FROM b.base_currency))) AS mismatched_functional_legs,
            count(l_1.entry_id) FILTER (WHERE l_1.transaction_currency IS NOT NULL AND (l_1.transaction_currency IS DISTINCT FROM l_1.functional_currency OR l_1.fx_rate_to_functional <> 1::numeric)) AS foreign_currency_legs
           FROM ledger.ledger_books b
             LEFT JOIN ledger.accounting_periods p_1 ON p_1.ledger_book_id = b.ledger_book_id
             LEFT JOIN ledger.journal_legs l_1 ON l_1.period_id = p_1.period_id
          GROUP BY b.ledger_book_id, b.base_currency
        )
 SELECT l.entry_id,
    l.journal_entry_id,
    l.period_id,
    p.ledger_book_id,
    e.base_currency,
    COALESCE(p.status, 'Unknown'::text) AS period_status,
    l.occurred_at,
        CASE
            WHEN p.ledger_book_id IS NULL THEN 'UnresolvedLedgerBook'::text
            WHEN e.base_currency IS NULL THEN 'UnusableBaseCurrency'::text
            WHEN e.mismatched_functional_legs > 0 THEN 'FunctionalCurrencyMismatch'::text
            WHEN e.foreign_currency_legs > 0 THEN 'ForeignCurrencyEvidence'::text
            WHEN e.currency_bearing_legs = 0 THEN 'UnaffirmedSingleCurrency'::text
            ELSE 'Repairable'::text
        END AS disposition
   FROM ledger.journal_legs l
     LEFT JOIN ledger.accounting_periods p ON p.period_id = l.period_id
     LEFT JOIN book_currency_evidence e ON e.ledger_book_id = p.ledger_book_id
  WHERE l.transaction_currency IS NULL;

views.definition:
WITH book_currency_evidence AS (
         SELECT b.ledger_book_id,
                CASE
                    WHEN upper(TRIM(BOTH FROM b.base_currency)) ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'::text THEN upper(TRIM(BOTH FROM b.base_currency))
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END AS base_currency,
            count(l_1.entry_id) FILTER (WHERE l_1.transaction_currency IS NOT NULL) AS currency_bearing_legs,
            count(l_1.entry_id) FILTER (WHERE l_1.transaction_currency IS NOT NULL AND l_1.functional_currency IS DISTINCT FROM upper(TRIM(BOTH FROM b.base_currency))) AS mismatched_functional_legs,
            count(l_1.entry_id) FILTER (WHERE l_1.transaction_currency IS NOT NULL AND (l_1.transaction_currency IS DISTINCT FROM l_1.functional_currency OR l_1.fx_rate_to_functional <> 1::numeric)) AS foreign_currency_legs
           FROM ledger.ledger_books b
             LEFT JOIN ledger.accounting_periods p_1 ON p_1.ledger_book_id = b.ledger_book_id
             LEFT JOIN ledger.journal_legs l_1 ON l_1.period_id = p_1.period_id
          GROUP BY b.ledger_book_id, b.base_currency
        )
 SELECT l.entry_id,
    l.journal_entry_id,
    l.period_id,
    p.ledger_book_id,
    e.base_currency,
    COALESCE(p.status, 'Unknown'::text) AS period_status,
    l.occurred_at,
        CASE
            WHEN p.ledger_book_id IS NULL THEN 'UnresolvedLedgerBook'::text
            WHEN e.base_currency IS NULL THEN 'UnusableBaseCurrency'::text
            WHEN e.mismatched_functional_legs > 0 THEN 'FunctionalCurrencyMismatch'::text
            WHEN e.foreign_currency_legs > 0 THEN 'ForeignCurrencyEvidence'::text
            WHEN e.currency_bearing_legs = 0 THEN 'UnaffirmedSingleCurrency'::text
            ELSE 'Repairable'::text
        END AS disposition
   FROM ledger.journal_legs l
     LEFT JOIN ledger.accounting_periods p ON p.period_id = l.period_id
     LEFT JOIN book_currency_evidence e ON e.ledger_book_id = p.ledger_book_id
  WHERE l.transaction_currency IS NULL;
views.name: journal_leg_currency_backfill_status
